Flow-control context and inline publish and advance helpers for fragment caches.

# Purpose
This header defines the shared data structures and inline helper functions used by the `fd_stem` flow-control and publish path. The `fd_stem_context_t` structure stores per-output cache pointers, sequence counters, and credit accounting state, while `fd_stem_tile_in_t` stores per-input state such as the current cache line, expected sequence number, and diagnostic counters. The [`fd_stem_publish`](<#fd_stem_publish>) function publishes a fragment to an output cache, updates credit availability, and advances the output sequence number. The [`fd_stem_advance`](<#fd_stem_advance>) function performs the same credit and sequence update without publishing a fragment, which supports cases where the pipeline must skip or consume an output slot.
